map.综合AMH、基础FSH/E2、AFC评估卵巢储备功能与生育潜力: Combine AMH, baseline FSH/E2, AFC to assess ovarian reserve and fertility potential
map.AMH 分级：<0.5 极低、<1.0 低、<3.5 正常、<6.0 偏高、≥: AMH tiers: <0.5 very low, <1.0 low, <3.5 normal, <6.0 high, >=6.0 very high; FSH <10 normal; AFC >=8 normal
map.综合 AMH/FSH/AFC/年龄 评分，≥ 4 分提示卵工叶储减退(DOR)，: Combined AMH/FSH/AFC/age score, >=4 suggests diminished ovarian reserve (DOR); AMH >6 suggests high response (PCOS).
map.卵巢反应极差,获卵数少: Very poor ovarian response, few eggs retrieved
map.注：AMH不受月经周期影响，可在周期任何时间检测。AMH随年龄下降，是卵巢储备最: Note: AMH is unaffected by cycle and can be tested anytime. AMH falls with age and is the most stable reserve marker.
map.反映窦前卵泡池大小，是卵巢储备最敏感指标，随年龄递减: Reflects the primordial follicle pool; the most sensitive reserve marker, declining with age
map.需D2-5检测，升高提示储备减退(反馈性升高): Test on D2-5; elevated suggests diminished reserve (feedback rise)
map.2–10mm窦卵泡数，与AMH高度相关: 2-10 mm antral follicles, highly correlated with AMH
map.卵巢储备反映卵子数量，但不直接反映卵子质量(质量与年龄更相关): Reserve reflects egg quantity, not directly quality (quality relates more to age)
map.35岁后生育力加速下降，40岁后显著降低: Fertility drops faster after 35, markedly after 40
map.卵巢储备评估预测的是\"数量\"和\"卵巢反应性\"，不能完全预测能否自然妊娠。: Reserve assessment predicts "quantity" and ovarian response, not natural-pregnancy certainty. Low reserve != cannot conceive; combine age, tubes, male factors.
map.提示：各实验室AMH检测方法不同，参考范围可能有差异，建议以报告参考值为准。AM: Tip: labs differ in AMH assays and reference ranges; defer to the report. AMH is the best predictor of IVF ovarian response. For assessment reference only.
map.联合 AMH、FSH、AFC、年龄四项评估储备。: Combine AMH, FSH, AFC and age to assess reserve.
map.预测 IVF 获卵数与反应。: Predict IVF egg yield and response.
map.AMH 0.6（<1 加 2 分）、FSH 18（≥15 加 3 分）、AFC: AMH 0.6 (+2), FSH 18 (+3), AFC 4 (+2), age 39 (+1): total 8 >=4, diagnosis DOR.
map.AMH 7.5（>6 减 1 分）、FSH 6、AFC 25、年龄 28：AMH: AMH 7.5 (-1), FSH 6, AFC 25, age 28: high AMH suggests PCOS high response; prevent OHSS in ART.
map.评分越高越差吗？: Does a higher score mean worse?
map.否，本评分是风险积分：AMH 低、FSH 高、AFC 少、年龄大均加分，总分越高: No—this is a risk score: low AMH, high FSH, few AFC, older age add points; very high AMH subtracts, flagging high response.
map.能，但获卵少、妊娠率下降，建议尽早评估并考虑辅助生殖；仍有自然妊娠可能。: Yes, but fewer eggs and lower pregnancy rate; assess early and consider ART; natural conception still possible.
map.卵巢储备(AMH/FSH)评估器，通过AMH、基础FSH、AFC等指标评估卵巢储: The ovarian-reserve assessor evaluates reserve and fertility potential via AMH, baseline FSH, AFC, etc. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
